Elena —

Appreciate the quick note and congrats on signing. Attaching a draft MAP (BrightHealth_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) and a short canary-checklist PDF that outlines the gates we intend to use. High level here so you have context:  

1) Rollout cadence (4-week phased rollout)
   - Week 0 (Prep): network whitelisting, KMS keys exchange, and non-prod dry-run
   - Week 1 (Canary 1): 2% production traffic, QA smoke tests, latency & error SLAs
   - Week 2 (Canary 2): 10% traffic, user acceptance spot checks, routing fallback ready
   - Week 3 (Canary 3): 30% traffic, end-to-end verification with downstream services
   - Week 4 (Full): 100% traffic cutover + 72h high-touch monitoring window

2) Evaluation plan (embedded in the MAP workbook)
   - Core signals: token latency p50/p95, error rate, output-quality regression on curated prompt set
   - Quality gates: automatic rollback threshold at +15% error or >200ms p95 increase over baseline
   - Manual checkpoints: product and ops sign-off at each canary gate

3) Migration & cutover
   - Database read-only snapshot window planned for Full cutover (2-hour window)
   - Fallback policy: immediate route back to blue instance if CLI health check fails

4) Training & enablement
   - Train-the-trainer session (2 hours) one week prior to Canary 1
   - Weekly office hours during canaries, daily for first 72h after Full cutover

5) On-call escalation
   - Primary Redwood contact: karthik_iyer@redwood.example (first 30 days)
   - Secondary: marcus_lin@redwood.example

Next steps: please confirm the 2-hour cutover window preference (we recommended Sat 02:00–04:00 PT) and we’ll lock calendar invites.

Thanks — attaching the files.
